howFarTheProofOfLifeMovesForward: How far the proof of life moves forward each time an owner checks in.
howMuchCombinedSigningPowerATransactionN: How much combined signing power a transaction needs before it can spend.
ifNoOwnerSignsBeforeThisMomentRecovery: If no owner signs before this moment, recovery contacts can claim the wallet.
name: Name
onlyTheLabelYouSeeItChangesNothing: Only the label you see. It changes nothing about who can spend.
personAddedDetail: This person can spend from the wallet once the transaction is signed.
personChangedDetail: Their keys, spending limit, voting power, or timer right are not what they were.
personRemovedDetail: This person loses access as soon as the transaction is signed.
recoveryContactAddedDetail: They can claim this wallet once the proof of life runs out.
recoveryContactChangedDetail: The keys that can claim this wallet, their share, or their extra wait have moved.
recoveryContactRemovedDetail: They can no longer claim this wallet after the timer runs out.
recoveryContactsCanNeverClaimThisWalletW: Recovery contacts can never claim this wallet while the timer is off.
scheduledPaymentAddedDetail: This address can be paid from the wallet on this schedule.
scheduledPaymentChangedDetail: The payee, the rate, or the dates are not what they were.
scheduledPaymentRemovedDetail: This schedule stops. Nothing further accrues to that address.
thisTransactionWouldRewriteTheWalletSRul: This transaction would rewrite the wallet's rules to what they already are.
